newsitem.title: USA: Dow up 50, NYSE re-imposes curbs just before close.
newsitem.headline: Dow up 50, NYSE re-imposes curbs just before close.

text.p: U.S. blue chips returned to solidly higher levels as program activity produced a flurry of volatilily in the last minutes of trading on Tuesday.
The Dow industrials stood at 7724, up 51 points for the session, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to re-impose program trading curbs at 1558 EDT/1958 GMT, just two minutes before the close.
